lady.summary: The model is the court lady from the mockup: red hair in a high bun with a pearl band, a sage green gown with a cream front panel, a flower fan, and a small green purse. The differences are small: a narrower skirt, a raised fan, and less lace.
strengths: The red bun, the pearl hair band, and the pearl earrings match the mockup and read from every view.
The sage green and cream palette matches the mockup, and the red hair gives a clear focal accent.
The face has a closed friendly smile, and it reads in the front sprites.
All signature items are present: the fan with pink flowers, the small green purse, and the puff sleeves.
issues: The skirt is narrower and plainer than the full ball gown in the mockup. Make the skirt wider at the hem and add soft folds.
The fan is raised beside the shoulder. The mockup holds the open fan in front of the chest. The role text permits the raised fan, but a lower fan is closer to the mockup.
The cream front panel has only a few dots. The mockup shows lace rows and a lace bodice. Add lace bands on the panel.
The collar is a white ruff. The mockup shows a lace collar and a pearl necklace. Add the pearl necklace.
The hair is a dome of waves that covers much of the forehead. The mockup shows a smooth front with loose side locks.
lady.next: Make the skirt wider and fuller at the hem, with lace rows on the cream front panel.

masked-agent.summary: The model is a friendly masked agent in a purple cloak and a white half mask, with one fist at the chin and a sealed letter in the other hand. It is the same character as the mockup, but the hood shape and the missing long hair are clear differences.
strengths: The white half mask with a gold rim and the dark grey double-breasted coat with silver buttons match the mockup.
The pose matches the mockup: one fist at the chin and the sealed letter with a purple seal held out.
The purple and dark grey palette matches the mockup, and the white mask is a clear focal point.
issues: The hood is tall with a pointed tip, like a gnome hat. The mockup hood is soft and rounded and falls around the face. Make the hood lower and rounder.
The long black hair that falls from the hood in the mockup is missing. The model shows only short bangs. Add long locks at the sides of the face.
The cloak back is one heavy lumpy mass. In the back sprites the character is only a purple shape. Add clear folds and a hem line to the cloak.
The legs are short and stubby. The mockup shows longer dark trousers and boots.
The fist at the chin touches the face edge. Check that the fist does not enter the mask or the chin in the clips.
masked-agent.next: Change the hood to a soft rounded hood and add long hair locks at the sides of the face.

spy.summary: The model is a young spy in a dark green hood and cloak, with a brass spyglass raised in one fist and a folded note in the other. Hair tips come through the hood, and the open mouth with a fang tooth is different from the closed smile in the mockup.
strengths: The brown leather vest with straps, buckles, and pouches matches the mockup.
The brass spyglass and the folded note with a red seal are present and the fists hold them.
The green, brown, and grey palette matches the mockup, and the face reads in the front sprites.
issues: Dark hair tips come through the outer surface of the hood on the character's left side. They show in the front, three-quarter, and side views. Keep all hair inside the hood.
The mouth is open with a small fang-like tooth. The mockup shows a closed smile. Change the mouth to a closed smile.
The hood is a smooth round dome with a small tip. The mockup hood is soft and loose, with messy hair that spills out. Make the hood looser and let more hair show at the front.
The cloak back is one smooth green bell. Add folds and a hem line so the back reads as cloth.
The mockup cloak is darker and more muted. The model green is a little bright.
spy.next: Remove the hair tips that come through the hood, then change the mouth to a closed smile.
spy.criticalReason: Dark hair tips come through the outer surface of the hood on the character's left side.

rebel.summary: The model is a young rebel scout with a red headband, a red neckerchief, a green jacket, a rolled red flag, and a slingshot. It is the same character as the mockup, but the flag pole is short and the jacket and trousers lose the patched, ragged look.
strengths: The red headband with tails, the red neckerchief, and the dark topknot match the mockup and read in every sprite direction.
The face has a closed hopeful smile and strong brows, as in the mockup.
The red accents at the head, neck, and flag give a clear focal plan against the green jacket.
issues: The flag pole is short and ends at the fist. The mockup pole is long and reaches the ground, with a gold spear tip. Make the pole long so the flag is the main silhouette shape.
The flag is a rolled red and gold tube with a red curved tail. The mockup shows a red flag that hangs from the pole. Make the cloth hang from the top of the pole.
The jacket has clean vertical stripes. The mockup jacket is olive with patches. Add two or three patches with stitches.
The brown trousers with a ragged hem in the mockup are missing. The model shows short legs with cream cuffs. Add brown trousers with a ragged hem.
The slingshot hangs low at the hip. The mockup holds the slingshot up and out to the side.
rebel.next: Make the flag pole long, from the ground to above the head, with the red flag hanging from the top.
